title: U-Pick Orchards
new_html:
1. Kalchik Farms
Info: U-Pick Farms USA listing
Phone: (231) 377-7519
Location: 8659 Bellaire Highway, Bellaire, MI 49615
Family-run and beloved for u-pick strawberries in June. A sweet summer staple just minutes away.

2. King Orchards
Website: kingorchards.com
Phone: (231) 544-6479
Location: 4620 N M-88, Central Lake
A wide seasonal roster of u-pick fruit, from June strawberries through cherries, raspberries, peaches and October apples, plus a farm market with baked goods and picnic areas. Check their site for the current u-pick schedule.

3. Shooks Farms / Cellar 1914
Websites: shooksfarms.weebly.com and cellar1914.com
Phone: (231) 544-6418
Location: 5833 Shooks Road, Central Lake, MI 49622
A multi-generation family farm known for u-pick cherries in July (sweet and pie varieties). On the same property is Cellar 1914, their winery and tasting room, where you can enjoy wines and hard ciders crafted from the farm's own fruit. A perfect pick-and-sip stop.

4. Rocky Top Farms
Website: rockytopfarms.com
Phone: (231) 350-0985
Location: 11486 Essex Rd, Ellsworth, MI
A cherry farm famous for farm-kitchen preserves, fruit butters, gift boxes, and cedar kitchen items, with a farm store on site. A charming stop for shopping local culinary treats.

5. Clam Lake Orchards
Info: Orange Pippin listing
Phone: (231) 533-6497
Location: 6662 Clam Lake Road, Bellaire, MI 49615
About 30 apple varieties, including Fuji, Gala, Honeycrisp, and McIntosh, some on easy-to-reach dwarf trees. Call ahead to confirm they are open.
